scope_note: A new section in the coverage-completion round the repository owner authorised on 2026-09-14 (audits/coverage/2026-09-14/STUDY-GUIDE-COVERAGE-COMPLETION-PLAN.json); no earlier audit binds it. All four planned records were replaced before freezing: MA-HORMONAL-CONTRACEPTIVE (cites the 2023 circular letter DCP 23-10-121, which the Department's DCP 26-08-125 of 2026-08-25 has overtaken, and carries unsourced exception boilerplate) by MA-CONTRACEPTION-PHARMACIST-AUTHORITY (M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 19F(a) as rewritten by St. 2025, c. 14, s. 39), MA-CONTRACEPTION-PRESCRIBING-REGULATION (105 CMR 700.004(B)(15)) and MA-CONTRACEPTION-DCP-GUIDANCE (the 2026 circular, taught as guidance); MA-CONTRACEPTION-NO-APPOINTMENT and MA-CONTRACEPTION-POST-PRESCRIBING (glosses on the statute) by MA-CONTRACEPTION-RULES-MANDATE, which states s. 19F(b) and (c) as directions for the rules; and MA-EPT (attributes the authority to Board Policy 2020-08) by MA-EPT-PRACTITIONER-AUTHORITY (M.G.L. c. 111, s. 121B as amended by St. 2024, c. 140, and 105 CMR 700.003(H)), MA-EPT-DISPENSING-POLICY (Policy 2020-08, taught as dispensing procedure) and MA-EPT-EPRESCRIBING-EXCEPTION (105 CMR 721.070(A)(7) and (C) and 721.020(D)(4)). Added for in-scope law no record carried: MA-FAMILY-PLANNING-MEDICATION-ACCESS (Board Policy 2023-05 with 247 CMR 9.19(1)(f)) and MA-MASSHEALTH-OTC-CONTRACEPTIVE-STANDING-ORDER (M.G.L. c. 118E, s. 83 and the signed standing order of 2025-01-27). Official texts disagree in two places the section shows as they stand: the General Laws page for s. 19F still displays subsection (a) as it read before St. 2025, c. 14, and 105 CMR 721.070(A)(7) and the Policy 2020-08 web page cite 700.003(J) where the regulation and the policy PDF place EPT at 700.003(H). Pharmacist prescribing of HIV and STI medications under s. 19F(a)(ii) and the December 2025 labeling advisory for reproductive and gender-affirming prescriptions are named as boundaries, not taught. Scope gate: every signal declined. They are other paragraphs of 105 CMR 700.003 and 700.004 taught elsewhere (the MA-ADMIN-* administration records, MA-PHARMACY-IMMUNIZATION-ADMINISTRATION, MA-NALOXONE-REGISTRATION-EXEMPTION, the MA-EMERGENCY-VACCINE-* records, the MA-CDTM-* prescribing records and MA-PHARMACIST-PRESCRIBER-ID); 105 CMR 700.004(A) registration records (MA-DPH-PRACTITIONER-REGISTRATION, MA-DPH-REGISTRANT-SCOPE); prescription-format records for 105 CMR 721.000 outside the EPT exception (MA-EMERGENCY-SITUATION-EXCEPTION, MA-ORAL-CS-FOLLOWUP-TIMING, MA-RX-FAILOVER-ORAL, MA-RX-NO-SUBSTITUTION-INDICATION, MA-RX-WRITTEN-FORMAT); MA-MLID-REFERENCE-COPY (another paragraph of 247 CMR 9.19(1)); MA-RX-FORMAT-CONTENT and MA-CONTROLLED-EPRESCRIBE, left uncited because each adds a gloss the texts do not contain, with the points the section needs grounded on MA-EPT-EPRESCRIBING-EXCEPTION; and MA-EPT, the record replaced above. Practice links: MA-Q-0095, MA-Q-0141 to MA-Q-0144, MA-Q-0176 to MA-Q-0178, MA-Q-0345 and MA-Q-0346; MA-Q-0096 treats a clinical-visit follow-up period as in force and MA-Q-0347 attributes a regulatory duty to the statute, so both left the links.
